entries.what: Grace arrives at Flats High at 7:20 to beat the Vinca drop-off line, supervises semester midterms in B12 and teaches her periods.
During prep she fills in the required conference logs early, then asks her assistant to rephrase one comment so it does not sound snippy toward the office. Lunch is leftover rice and ulam in B12.
entries.outcome: Logs finished days ahead of the deadline with the comment softened.

entries.what: Evening at home on Tamarisk Court: dinner, then the weeknight teleserye with Nanay at 9.
First day of fall parent conferences. Minimum day, with 12:30-6 slots back to back in B12 after morning classes.
entries.outcome: Met a full afternoon of parents; nothing went wrong.

entries.what: Tuesday lunch lab-makeup session, then she walks home late after the last conference.
entries.outcome: Makeup labs done; she gets home after dark.

entries.what: Eats a late dinner Lola Cora kept warm and checks midterm scores on the district laptop.
entries.outcome: Stack of midterms left for later.

entries.what: Second conference day: short morning classes, then afternoon conference slots in B12.
entries.outcome: Another full block of parents seen.

entries.what: After conferences she picks up Corazón's prescriptions at the Vinca Avenue drugstore on her Wednesday.
Evening: dinner with Ramón's absence noted on the fridge calendar; short talk with Isabel about Thanksgiving chores.
entries.outcome: Chore list agreed without a fight.

entries.what: Third and last conference day, Thursday; eats lunch in B12 with Dana, who vents about her evaluations.
Grades remaining midterms at home after dinner, with the leaf-blower email to the city still on her mind.
Watches the teleserye with Corazón and checks the Friday form data.
Last midterm day: she teaches her five sections and proctors in B12.
Submits the Friday form at 3:30 from her spreadsheet template.
Evening at home, takeout dinner with Isabel, Corazón and Ramón.
Packs boxes at the Our Lady of the Marsh Thanksgiving food drive, 8-11 a.m., with Father Ben.
Shops at Ruiz Family Market and stops at Panadería Las Hermanas for rolls and conchas.
Pays the second-weekend household bills and plans the week; first hatchback payment was due Nov 15.
Tagalog Mass at 9 with Corazón at Our Lady of the Marsh, then Sunday sinigang lunch.
Grades at the kitchen table, then plans Thanksgiving seating for 11 so her mother sits near the bathroom, without telling the guests why.
entries.outcome: Seating chart drafted with the reason kept private.

entries.what: Sunday evening she uses the assistant to sort the week ahead before Thanksgiving.
